row: PRESET-STREAM-ANIM-01, the decode chips box by box (plan 70 flow 2b.10)
deck_time: 2026-09-26 13:48-13:52 and 14:01-14:03 EDT (a usage-limit stop in between)
setup: chip style decode, one chip (the saved settings); Main tab, test chat

box_block_of_symbols_settling_left_to_ri.how: a single screenshot is too slow (the settle is over in about 1.5 s), so a 14 s screen recording was taken and the chip area cut out at 10 frames a second
box_block_of_symbols_settling_left_to_ri.seen: each new question arrives as a full-width line of scrambled symbols; the real words lock in from the left behind a solid block caret, over about 15 frames (1.5 s): e.g. 'How <symbols>' -> 'How can I opti[caret] <symbols>' -> 'How can I optimize for Hr<symbols>' -> 'How can I optimize for battery li[caret] T' -> 'How can I optimize for battery life?'
box_block_of_symbols_settling_left_to_ri.strip: plan70-PRESET-STREAM-ANIM-01-settling.png (10 frames top to bottom, two settles)

box_green_blinking_caret.measured: the caret block's colour in the frames is about RGB 214,228,236 - a pale white-blue, the same as the settled letters - not green (the answer scramble colour setting is 'green', but the chip caret did not use it)
box_green_blinking_caret.verdict: FAIL on 'green' as written (the caret is there and moves left to right; its colour is not green)

box_chip_takes_the_ring_while_settling.seen: with the ring on the chip, the chip churned to a new question and the ring stayed on it (13:47 and 14:01); page read: ring on the chip, text 'How can I opti[caret]<symbols>'

box_A_selects_the_full_prompt.pressed: A on the chip about half a second after its churn was seen starting ('How can I opti[caret]...'); done once
box_A_selects_the_full_prompt.box_text_after: 'How can I optimize for battery life?' - the whole prompt, no symbols
box_A_selects_the_full_prompt.cleared_with: the screen's own Clear (X) button next to Ask: box empty afterwards (note: after Clear, no control held the ring until the next press)
box_A_selects_the_full_prompt.caveat: the press could not be timed to the exact frame; the churn lasts about 1.5 s and the press landed inside that window by the timing of the reads

side_observation: at 13:49-13:52 the chip stopped changing for over 3 minutes; the Steam screensaver page had come up (seen at 14:00), which freezes panel animations - not a plugin fault
verdict: PASS for the settle, ring-while-settling and A-gives-the-whole-prompt boxes; FAIL on the caret being green
